road: Km 0.5 to 25 fully graded: crown trimmed, carriageway widened from 5 m to 6 m.
Remaining 12 km on hold. Grader steering hose blown, waiting since 13 Oct; workshop fixing it.
KM37 junction to Aiambak extremely rough. Grader patrol requested. Drive to conditions.
